# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

print(f"Number of internal test orders: {len(test_orders)}")

# Check the revenue column type and first few values
print("First few values of 'revenue' (before cleaning):")
print(df['revenue'].head())

# Confirm if the premise about test orders is true
assert len(test_orders) == 6, "Expected exactly 6 internal test orders"

# Confirm if the revenue column is string
assert df['revenue'].dtype == 'object', "Revenue should be string type"

# Print a sample of the revenue values to check for commas
print("Sample of revenue values with commas:")
print(df['revenue'].sample(5))"}
